title: SCA Yom Kippur Message: "Shifting Your Perspective" by Mrs. Rachelle Tawil

chapters.title: Approaching Yom Kippur with Dread vs. Joy
chapters.about: Dread of the fast versus the Talmud teaching that Yom Kippur is a happy day

chapters.title: Lessons from Yona
chapters.about: Yona running away, the storm, the fish, and Ninve

chapters.title: Shifting Focus on Yom Kippur
chapters.about: Embracing the day, knowing forgiveness is inevitable, and focusing on tefillah

summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses how to shift our mentality and approach Yom Kippur with excitement rather than dread, focusing on a clean slate and forgiveness. She uses the book of Yona to illustrate that we cannot run away from Hashem and that forgiveness is inevitable. She encourages listeners to shift focus from material things to tefillah to achieve a fresh start.
questions: Why do people feel dread instead of excitement for Yom Kippur?
What does the Talmud teach about Yom Kippur?
What lessons can we learn from Yona on Yom Kippur?
How can we change our focus on Yom Kippur?
